newsitem.title: USA: Selfcare sees $3.8 mln oper loss in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Selfcare sees $3.8 mln oper loss in Q1.

text.p: Selfcare Inc said Friday it expects to report a first quarter operating loss of roughly $3.8 million on revenues of $9.1 million.

Selfcare said during the quarter it accelerated its research and development expenditures on non-invasive technology programs and brought forward several pre-launch production programs at its facility in Inverness, Scotland, for its electrochemical blood glucose monitoring system.
It also said its first quarter results were adversely affected by a reduction in revenues from its Brazilian subsidiary, and by the effect of currency translation.
